subject: Site coordination clash: retaining wall footing conflicting with the underground utility

messages.text: Coordination clash identified: retaining wall footing conflicting with the underground utility corridor at Placement Zone 2, per Utility Plan C-301 vs Grading Plan C-201. This is becoming a priority as site work proceeds. This could affect the contract sum depending on the resolution. This is holding up site work in this area. A response Friday would be appreciated.
